author: How It Should Have Ended
description:
The Super Mario Galaxy HISHE!  Rosalina controls her stars, Bowser Jr meets a Starfox, and the whole Mario Gang goes the Super Cafe. Mario, Luigi, Peach, Toad, Yoshi, Fox McCloud, Rosalina, All of them!  An animated alternate ending/discussion of the Super Mario Galaxy Movie. Princess Peach meets a foul mouth Luma. The Emperor questions Bowser's evil status in the Villain Pub.
